acceptance_criteria: Part of PBI-049: standard Flutter web project in scrum/scrumboard (lib; test; web; pubspec.yaml; no dependency on the root app; arb copies synced from requirements/messages by a tool script); Dart server scrum/scrumboard/bin/server.dart serving build/web and a JSON API on 127.0.0.1 port 8081 with --port and --progress <dir> (SCB-13; SCB-13.a Host and Origin check; SCB-13.b read endpoints for this slice: requirements list per SCB-03.a; sprint file read and write per SCB-02.a to f at scrum/sprint.md; progress list; usage read from scrum/usage.md; anything else not found; UTF 8 per SCB-13.i); body limit and paths kept inside the root; no shell; README with the start command; no issue tracker; tests named with SCB IDs

title: ScrumBoard page layout with Reload and error messages
description: As the Product Owner I want the board page to fit the window in three rows and tell me when data cannot be read
acceptance_criteria: Part of PBI-049: SCB-15.a three rows 40/20/40 (middle row and the Issues and Questions columns are empty placeholders this slice); SCB-15.b own scrollbars; SCB-01.c Reload; SCB-01.d every label an arb key; SCB-01.f msg:scbLoadFailed in each place; SCB-13.h msg:scbServerUnreachable; SCB-01.g theme colors only; DEF-01 rows the board cites (sub-requirement indent; window sizes) added to common.md; tests named with SCB IDs

title: ScrumBoard Backlog block and read-only sprint timeline
description: As the Product Owner I want to see the Backlog block and the sprint blocks of the sprint file
acceptance_criteria: Part of PBI-049: SCB-06.a Backlog block lists the requirements with status backlog; SCB-06.e Backlog block fixed at left while the timeline scrolls sideways under it and opens at its right end; SCB-06.g every top-level block the same width with its own scroll; blocks and members read from the sprint file and nested per SCB-06.c; read only (no drag; no add; no lifecycle button); tests named with SCB IDs

title: ScrumBoard Features column with filters and outline
description: As the Product Owner I want the requirements listed as an outline that I can filter
acceptance_criteria: Part of PBI-049: SCB-03 and SCB-03.a to c; SCB-04 feature and requirement and status filters (SCB-04.a to d; shared filter UIC-21); SCB-11.a to f outline with triangles and the expand-all switch at the right end of the filter row; opens collapsed; Yamamoto adds the scb keys to the six arb files; tests named with SCB IDs

title: ScrumBoard drag and drop and status writes
description: As the Product Owner I want to build the sprint by dragging
acceptance_criteria: Part of PBI-049: SCB-07.a to i; SCB-13.c and SCB-13.d status changes in the requirement files; the set-status endpoint; nesting by drag (SCB-06.c)

title: ScrumBoard Issues column
description: As the Product Owner I want the open issues listed beside the requirements
acceptance_criteria: Part of PBI-049: SCB-05.a to e; SCB-04 for issues; SCB-11.g to i; SCB-01.b; SCB-13.e to g and SCB-13.i through the signed-in issue tracker command

title: ScrumBoard shared add popup

acceptance_criteria: Part of PBI-049: SCB-16.a to j; SCB-06.b; SCB-09.a to g; SCB-13.j

title: Hour height changed by press and hold on the hour axis
description: As a user I want to pull an hour on the left axis taller or shorter by pressing and holding it
acceptance_criteria: The Executive found the hour height is not implemented correctly (CAL-04.d); click and hold an hour label on the left axis and drag to make the hour taller or shorter; minimum is the height of a one line event; maximum is the height of a single window; the result is saved; tests for the limits and the drag; replaces the whole-lines control of CAL-04.d if the Product Owner agrees; from the Executive while Sprint 011 was running; not built in Sprint 011
